$schema_note: MTower Studio — locations catalog. A plate prompt describes the place with no main characters. light_variants list the look keys (studio/library/looks/looks.json) each production needs.

locations.name: Northern Sinai dunes
locations.prompt: rolling soft sand dunes of northern Sinai, sharp wind-rippled crests, fine sand blowing off the tops, empty horizon

locations.name: Romani–Baluza coastal road
locations.prompt: a straight two-lane asphalt road running dead flat through open desert to the horizon, sandy shoulders, a low barbed-wire fence on pickets along one side

locations.name: Tina Plain salt marsh (سهل الطينة)
locations.region: Northern Sinai, east of the Suez Canal
locations.prompt: a vast flat salt marsh, thin white salt crust over black mud, shallow brine mostly at mid-shin depth (between ankle and knee, never above the knee), patches and sheets of shallow water reflecting the sky between the salt crust, not a lake, no features to the horizon
qa_rules: The marsh is shallow: brine and mud mostly reach mid-shin (between ankle and knee) on standing men, up to the knee only in a few deeper pockets, never above the knee. Water at the thighs or waist, or men wading as if through a lake or river, is wrong (except a man who has fallen or is kneeling).

locations.name: Flat open desert (no cover)
locations.prompt: perfectly flat open desert like a carpet, no rocks, no hills, no cover, shallow ripples in the sand, a straight road in the distance

locations.name: Military airfield with tree groves (Salhiya)
locations.region: East of the Nile Delta, Egypt
locations.prompt: a military airfield apron with tree groves of eucalyptus and scrub beside it, a dispersal area under the trees with soldiers' kit

locations.name: Nile Delta village: house, lane, grocery
locations.prompt: a mud-brick house with an open courtyard and a domed clay bread oven, chickens, a narrow dirt lane, lush green Delta fields and palm trees beyond; a small village grocery with a bench outside

locations.name: Cairo one-room flat, stairwell, and alley (Shubra)
locations.prompt: one small room with a mattress on the floor, a wardrobe with a suitcase on top, a framed photo on the wall, window glass painted dark blue; a narrow stairwell; an alley with laundry lines

locations.name: Military training salt flats
locations.prompt: blinding white summer salt flats, shallow brine at ankle depth, a line of small solid-red triangular pennants on thin wooden stakes marking a finish line, a dusty parade ground beyond

locations.name: Army barracks room, 1970s
locations.prompt: a long military barracks room with iron bunks, a single bare bulb, kit laid out on grey blankets

locations.name: Suez Canal at night
locations.prompt: the Suez Canal at night, black still water, the far bank a low dark line

locations.name: Military command tent
locations.prompt: canvas military command tent with map boards on easels and a field table
